headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's new desktop app on macOS includes a 'Computer History' feature. It tracks user actions to learn work patterns and suggest automations. This data helps ChatGPT and Codex reference your activity timeline for requests.

headline: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
summary: The article explores the growing reality of AI safety concerns. It highlights how autonomous AI agents from OpenAI are challenging traditional sci-fi notions. The piece suggests that the concept of 'rogue AI' is no longer purely fictional.

headline: Polaroid’s tiny instant camera is $72 and includes a free pack of film
summary: Amazon is offering the second-generation Polaroid Go instant camera for $71.99. This deal includes a 16-photo film pack, marking its lowest price yet. It caters to those seeking the nostalgic charm of analog instant photography.

headline: Matt Groening lets slip that Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback
summary: Simpsons creator Matt Groening hinted at a potential return for 'Simpsons: Hit & Run'. The cult classic game's comeback was mentioned at D23. His remarks, alongside showrunner Matt Selman's, suggested strong possibility.

headline: Disney Experiences Showcase: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More | D23 2026
summary: D23 2026 revealed major updates for Disney Parks and Cruise Line. Announcements included Villains Land and Piston Peak National Park details. Previews for Encanto, Indiana Jones experiences, and Tomorrowland reimagining were also shown.

headline: 'I Want to Set the Record Straight: That Is Not Happening' — Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 developers confirmed the game will not be delayed. Co-director Tai Yasue and Tetsuya Nomura assured a '100%' late 2027 launch. This statement aims to quash any rumors or concerns about postponements.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer Featuring Playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy | D23 2026
summary: An extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 debuted at D23 2026. The trailer showcased a first look at playable King Mickey, Donald, and Goofy. Disney and Square Enix revealed these details during a dedicated panel.

headline: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit Lets You Keep Helping Hondo Ohnaka in Fortnite After You Leave Disneyland
summary: 'Smuggler's Gambit' expands the Smuggler's Run experience into Fortnite. It offers a PvE multiplayer online game where players assist Hondo Ohnaka. Linking Epic Games and MyDisney accounts unlocks a special theme park experience.

headline: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
summary: Russia reported at least seven fatalities in what it called Ukraine's largest attack of 2026. Moscow also launched deadly retaliatory strikes against Ukraine overnight. These strikes sparked widespread fires across the capital city, Kyiv.

headline: Watch: BBC visits smouldering market in Ukraine after strikes
summary: The BBC visited a smouldering market in Ukraine following recent strikes. Six people were injured in the attack on the market selling various goods. Footage captured the devastation and immediate aftermath of the incident.

headline: Emergency phone alert put domestic abuse victims at risk, campaigners say
summary: A nationwide emergency phone alert put millions on edge last Friday night. Campaigners argue the alert inadvertently put domestic abuse victims at risk. The loud, sudden alarm could reveal hidden phones or safe locations.

headline: Murder inquiry after man bitten by dog dies
summary: Police have launched a murder inquiry after a man died from a dog bite. Authorities are appealing for two specific individuals to come forward. These people reportedly stopped to help the victim in Wakefield.
